title: microcorys longifolia
intro: Microcorys longifolia, commonly known as Jungleweed, is a species of flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Australia. The health benefits of Microcorys longifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Microcorys longifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
